text:
elaine: CI is red on integrations against hosted-api — failing auth handshake and a couple tool-call tests. Anyone picking this up? Repro on main branch.

aj: looking now.

aj: can you paste failing test names and a short log snippet?

elaine: failing tests: TestHostedAuthHandshake::test_token_rotate, TestToolCalling::test_tool_call_timeout, TestSchemaValidation::test_optional-field-order

elaine: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:03Z] auth: kid not found for token (token.kid=3a7f)
[2026-03-15T14:22:05Z] hosted-proxy -> tool-router 503 ServiceUnavailable
[2026-03-15T14:22:05Z] tool-router: upstream connection reset
```

maria: my runtime change yesterday shortened the kid cache TTL — wondering if that's the trigger. I rolled the change to canary only.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.internal/runs/98765 (shards 3,7,12)

sam: if rerun fails on same shard, we should bisect to confirm. I suspect the auth rotate PR (884) or the kid-ttl tweak.

raj: I'll kick off a bisect job and attach logs. ping me if you want to shadow.

ops-bot: quick check: tool-router metrics show a 15% 5xx spike in us-west-2 between 14:20-14:30 UTC, increased connection resets.

aj: thanks ops. maria — can you revert the cache change or add a fallback for missing kid?

maria: I can push a hotfix (fallback -> try jwks fetch on miss) but want rerun results first.

elaine: rerun finished: shard 3 PASSED, shard 7 FAILED (same 503), shard 12 flaky timeouts. attaching small excerpt above.

aj: starting bisect on main between sha abc123..def456 now.

raj: bisect job started: https://ci.internal/bisect/4242 — will post culprit when done.

maria: rolled back kid-cache in dedicated earlier, but canary still had the shorter TTL. I'll open a PR to revert + add extra logging.

elaine: if this is routing-related we should add a temporary failover to route tool calls to secondary pool for tests. Who owns routing policy?

sam: I got routing. Will add a failover rule to route to eu-pool-standby for test runs and notify ci-bot.

ci-bot: Failover policy applied to tool-router for duration of tests.

aj: ok rerun with failover?

ci-bot: New run queued: https://ci.internal/runs/98766 (with routing failover)

elaine: run green on all shards 🎉

maria: nice work. I'll still push revert + logging PR and link it here.

raj: bisect concluded: culprit commit 0a1f2b3 changed kid cache TTL from 6h -> 5m. Rolling back that change fixes auth handshake flakiness in our tests.

maria: PR opened: runtime#2345 revert short TTL + add metrics (https://git.internal/runtime/pull/2345)

elaine: follow-ups: 1) review & merge revert PR 2) add routing failover smoke to integration harness 3) add e2e test for missing-kid/jwks-fetch fallback

aj: assigned follow-ups to owners, created cards in our board. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident note: short auth-service config change increased 5xx to tool-router; mitigation (routing failover) applied. Mark resolved after PR merges.

elaine: closing thread — will follow up in PR and retrospective.Thanks all.
